family.description: This entry represents an alpha/beta domain found in the KIAA1549 protein from human ([swissprot:Q9HCM3]) which has been implicated in pilocytic astrocytomas [[cite:PUB00056166],[cite:PUB00056167],[cite:PUB00056168]]. It has been found to be fused to BRAF gene in many cases of pilocytic astrocytomas. The fusion is due mainly to a tandem duplication of 2 Mb at 7q34 [[cite:PUB00056166],[cite:PUB00056167]]. The BRAF protein is a well characterised oncoprotein. It is a serine/threonine protein kinase which is implicated in MAP/ERK signalling, a critical pathway for the regulation of cell division, differentiation and secretion [[cite:PUB00056166],[cite:PUB00056167],[cite:PUB00056168]]. More recently, KIAA1549 has been described to play a role in photoreceptor function [[cite:PUB00101492]]. This protein contains three homologous domains of this type found in tandem.
family.name: UPF0606 protein KIAA1549 alpha/beta domain 2
